sources.title: Duolingo — Server-Driven UI
sources.attribution: Primary engineering report. Configuration/data separation and versioning sections verified; experiment counts and release improvements are author-reported, not local measurements. No upstream code or illustrations copied; no redistribution license inferred.

sources.title: Google AIP-180 — Backwards Compatibility
sources.attribution: Approved API improvement proposal. Source/wire/semantic distinctions, renaming and pagination guidance verified. The page identifies CC BY 4.0 for text and Apache 2.0 for code samples; the lesson's Python fixture is original. Guidance is indicative and depends on transport and consumer scope.

sources.title: RFC 9110 — If-Match And Request Preconditions
sources.attribution: June 2022 HTTP Semantics, sections 8.8.3.2, 13.1.1 and 13.2.1. Strong comparison, prior request checks and already-applied exception verified. The lesson's strict policy and transition table are original review cases, not a server or storage-atomicity proof. No RFC code components copied; no blanket redistribution license inferred.

sources.title: Google AIP-160 — Filtering
sources.attribution: Approved guidance; typed/schema validation and documented complexity limits verified. The original work-order subset is not a complete implementation of the AIP filter grammar. Page text is CC BY 4.0; code samples are Apache 2.0. No upstream samples copied.

sources.title: Google AIP-158 — Pagination
sources.attribution: Approved guidance; page-size validation, empty nonterminal pages, query continuity, opaque tokens and separate authorization verified. The lesson does not implement a cursor or claim a live-data snapshot guarantee. Page text is CC BY 4.0; code samples are Apache 2.0. No upstream samples copied.

sources.title: Google AIP-157 — Partial Responses
sources.attribution: Approved guidance; view/default semantics and modern system-parameter versus legacy request-field mask guidance verified. The work-order views and write-payload review are original. Page text is CC BY 4.0; code samples are Apache 2.0. No upstream samples copied.
